[b]Grand Ages: Rome[/b] is the [b]sequel to the best-selling strategy game Imperium Romanum[/b].

As Governor of a Roman Province in the time-honoured Roman Empire, its fortune very much lies in your hands. Choose [b]one of five Roman noble families[/b] such as Caesar’s Julii with different abilities to accomplish the comprehensive missions.

[b]Defend yourself against barbarian tribes[/b], [b]trade with other cultures[/b], [b]build a wealthy economic environment[/b] and fullfil the needs of your people in a huge single player campaign!
